content: {"doneWhen":{"all":[{"path":"player","op":"at","value":{"x":11,"y":1}}]},"modes":[{"id":"flee","priority":20,"when":{"all":[{"path":"monster","op":"within","value":2},{"path":"health","op":"below","value":50}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"flee-monsters"}},{"id":"navigate","priority":10,"when":{"all":[{"path":"always","op":"eq","value":true}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"reach-ladder"}}],"skills":[{"name":"reach-ladder","skill":"async (b) => { const path = [[2,8],[3,8],[4,8],[5,8],[6,8],[7,8],[8,8],[9,8],[10,8],[11,8],[11,7],[11,6],[11,5],[11,4],[11,3],[11,2],[11,1]]; for (const [x,y] of path) { const r = await b.walkTo(x,y,'stand'); if (!r.ok) { b.log('walk failed '+x+','+y+' '+r.reason); } } const body = await b.body(); b.log('at '+body.x+','+body.y); }","check":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); return {ok: p.x===11 && p.y===1, detail: 'pos '+p.x+','+p.y}; }"},{"name":"flee-monsters","skill":"async (b) => { const ms = await b.monsters(); const p = await b.body(); let best = null; for (const m of ms) { const d = Math.abs(m.x-p.x)+Math.abs(m.y-p.y); if (best===null || d<best.d) best = {m,d}; } if (best) { const dx = p.x - best.m.x; const dy = p.y - best.m.y; const tx = Math.max(1, Math.min(11, p.x + (dx>=0?1:-1))); const ty = Math.max(1, Math.min(8, p.y + (dy>=0?1:-1))); await b.walkTo(tx,ty,'stand'); } }","check":"async (b) => ({ok:true, detail:'flee step'})"}]}
